mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE rise > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over 2 months indicate broad demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with concurrent HOUST and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profitability and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days during supply shocks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 6 months strengthens labor markets, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth over prior 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (RSAFS > 750000), a 0.5% decline in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 750000 and HOUST declines > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with RSAFS > 750000 and HOUST decline > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicate manufacturing slowdown, reducing earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
